title: Common Law | National Liberty Alliance
summary: National Liberty Alliance page promoting common-law lectures, claiming un-codified common law outranks statutes and that people can open their own courts of record.

assertions.quote: the un-codified common law is the superior law of the people and the codified civil law is the special or inferior law of the government
We the People never gave our legislators authority to legislate our behavior

verdicts.note: The Constitution grants legislative power and states have broad police power to regulate conduct.

assertions.quote: when a free and independant Jury is seated, then a "Court of Record" is officially opened
